items.prompt: Four runners finish a race in these times: Dewi 12.4 s, Bayu 12.04 s, Amara 12.39 s, Leo 12.9 s. Who finished first?
hints: The fastest runner has the smallest time.
The whole number parts are all 12. Compare the tenths.
items.explanation: All times have 12 seconds. Bayu has 0 tenths, which is less than 3 or 4 or 9 tenths, so 12.04 is the smallest and Bayu is first.

options.why: 12.4 is more than 12.39 and more than 12.04. A longer time is slower.
12.39 is not the smallest. Compare tenths: 12.04 has 0 tenths.
12.9 is the biggest time, so Leo is the slowest.

items.prompt: Put these numbers in order, from the smallest to the largest.
hints: Write each number with three decimal places.
Compare the tenths, then the hundredths, then the thousandths.
items.explanation: With three places: 0.060, 0.590, 0.600 and 0.609. So the order is 0.06, 0.59, 0.6, 0.609.
